en-US.description: A small and beautiful desktop Markdown app for writing and notes, with WYSIWYG layout and AI assistance.
en-US.longDescription:
Writing, layout, AI assistance and publishing in an installer of a dozen-odd MB.
Small: about 12 MB on Windows and Linux and about 23 MB for the universal macOS build, with one-click in-app updates. Any folder can be a notebook and every note is standard Markdown, so you can open, sync or version it with other tools at any time. AI writing reuses the agents already signed in on your machine (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and more), with no separate API key. PDFs are generated straight from the editor's styling, with no LaTeX or printer driver to install.
Beautiful: WYSIWYG layout with 15 built-in layout themes, plus imported Typora themes for the light or dark appearance. Copy styled rich text into any editor, or publish straight to WeChat Official Account drafts; math becomes SVG and Mermaid diagrams become images automatically. Every change from an agent is shown as a paragraph- and word-level diff, and nothing applies until you accept it. Focus mode, typewriter mode, three editor widths and Typora-style paragraph shortcuts.
The editor is WYSIWYG on Tiptap 3 with a Markdown source mode to switch to at any time, covering headings, lists, task lists, quotes, highlights, superscript and subscript, links, images, tables, code blocks, KaTeX formulas and live-rendered Mermaid diagrams, with collapsible front matter. Images can be pasted, dropped or inserted by command, uploaded to a PicGo or PicList host, or saved in an assets folder beside the document.

zh-CN.description: 小而美的桌面 Markdown 写作与笔记应用，所见即所得排版，复用本机已登录的编程助手做 AI 写作。
zh-CN.longDescription:
写作、排版、AI 辅助与发布，装进一个十几 MB 的安装包。
小：Windows 与 Linux 安装包约 12 MB，macOS 通用包约 23 MB，支持应用内一键更新。任意文件夹即笔记库，文件均为标准 Markdown，可随时用其他工具打开、同步或纳入 Git。AI 写作复用本机已登录的 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等），无需额外的 API Key。PDF 按编辑区样式直接生成，无需安装 LaTeX 或打印驱动。
美：排版所见即所得，内置 15 种排版主题，也可导入 Typora 主题作为浅色或深色外观。复制带排版的富文本到任意编辑器，或直接发布到微信公众号草稿箱；公式自动转 SVG，Mermaid 图表自动转图片。Agent 的每处修改都以段落级与词级差异呈现，逐处接受或拒绝后才会生效。专注模式、打字机模式、三档编辑区宽度，以及与 Typora 一致的段落快捷键。
编辑器基于 Tiptap 3 的所见即所得，支持 Markdown 源码模式随时切换；标题、列表、任务列表、引用、高亮、上下标、链接、图片、表格、代码块、KaTeX 数学公式与 Mermaid 图表都覆盖到，front matter 可折叠显示与编辑。图片可粘贴、拖拽或命令插入，可上传至 PicGo / PicList 图床，或保存到文档同级的 assets 目录。
zh-CN.name: MarkGo
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
新增功能
- 双击顶部标题或空白区域即可进入 / 退出全屏；按住顶部拖动仍可移动窗口，顶部按钮不会误触发全屏切换。
优化改进
- 初始窗口宽高改为所在屏幕可用区域的约 85%，自动居中，并考虑显示缩放、任务栏和小屏幕的尺寸限制。
- 从已有窗口新建时，在来源窗口所在屏幕打开；初始尺寸只在窗口创建时设置，不影响后续手动调整。
